messages:
Ayesha: Archipelago Labs returned the RFP with a few non-standard asks: per-region P99 latency SLOs, a one-page capability matrix plus a short executive summary, and explicit SLA credit language they'd like in the POC. They want the packet by Thursday EOD.
Tom: got it. which regions do we need numbers for? EU/US/APAC? any special compliance asks?
Ayesha: EU/US/APAC yes. Compliance: SOC2, ISO, and they want an HSM option that is FIPS-compatible. Also they want an option to pre-warm capacity 10 minutes before scheduled spikes.
Nikhil: For perf I suggest conservative rows: Hosted: 45 QPS sustained @512 tokens (p95 ~210ms, p99 ~420ms); Dedicated (4xA100 equiv): 320 QPS sustained, p99 ~120ms, can pre-warm to absorb 8x bursts for up to 15 minutes. Private: provide ranges and note depends on customer infra and networking.
Tom: I'll build the one-page matrix with columns: Hosted / Dedicated / Private and additional columns for EU/US/APAC p99 if needed. I'll add a small executive summary paragraph.
LegalBot: Legal note: cannot accept SLA credit wording that guarantees payouts without review. Offer a template: "SLA credits available for verified downtime beyond SLOs" and propose review during contracting. Also advise: state "compatible with FIPS-validated HSMs" and provide BYOK flow details. Key rotation default 90 days; configurable in Private.
Ayesha: They asked for a burst billing formula that is simple. Can we propose: burst_fee = base_rate * max(0, (burst_QPS - commit_QPS)/commit_QPS) * minutes * 2.5. Provide numeric example.
Nikhil: Example to paste:
```
Commit = 250 QPS
Burst = 1250 QPS for 6 minutes
Excess_factor = (1250-250)/250 = 4
burst_fee = base_rate * 4 * 6 * 2.5
```
Tom: good. I'll add a footnote about autoscale smoothing (30s) and pre-warm window (10m) which can be requested ahead of known events. Also add quantization row: 8-bit supported, 4-bit experimental with model caveats.
PerfBot: bench job archipelago-5070001234 started on ephemeral cluster; ETA 70m. Will post p50/p95/p99 and batching assumptions.
Ayesha: Action items: Tom finalize matrix + exec summary; Nikhil update perf numbers after bench; Legal attach SOC2 and BYOK wording; I'll assemble and send. Please drop files in /sales/archipelago by 5pm PT Wednesday. :thumbsup:
Tom: will do. Ping me if legal needs different language.
LegalBot: Will upload SOC2 snapshot and BYOK appendix within the hour.
Nikhil: I'll follow up with short benchmark blurb and sample logs once PerfBot finishes.
Ayesha: Thanks all — keeping this thread for final sign-off.
